---
title: "Figure 1 - Observed Weighted Life-Satisfaction Trajectories"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r figure1}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FIGURE 1
# Observed life-satisfaction trajectories in parent and
# entropy-balanced non-parenting couples
#
# Primary ATT analysis:
#   Parents       n = 709 couples, weight = 1
#   Non-parenting n = 893 couples, entropy-balanced ATT weights
#
# Outcomes themselves are NOT imputed.
# Only the entropy weights vary across the 20 imputations.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paths
PARENT_PATH <- here(
  "data", "derived", "parent.rds"
)

CONTROL_PATH <- here(
  "data", "derived", "childless.rds"
)

WEIGHTS_PATH <- here(
  "data", "derived", "ebal_att_datasets.rds"
)

FIGURE_DIR <- here("figures")

dir.create(
  FIGURE_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  file.exists(PARENT_PATH),
  file.exists(CONTROL_PATH),
  file.exists(WEIGHTS_PATH)
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load observed longitudinal outcomes
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

parent_long <- readRDS(PARENT_PATH)
control_long <- readRDS(CONTROL_PATH)
weight_list <- readRDS(WEIGHTS_PATH)

stopifnot(length(weight_list) == 20L)

# Same observed outcome grid used in 09_prepare_mplus_weighted_outcomes.Rmd
outcome_long <- bind_rows(
  parent_long %>%
    mutate(group = 1L),
  control_long %>%
    mutate(group = 0L)
) %>%
  transmute(
    couple_id = as.character(couple_id),
    group = as.integer(group),
    pid = as.numeric(pid),
    sex = as.numeric(sex),
    signal = as.integer(signal),
    life_sat = as.numeric(life_sat)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # signal 0 = -3 years; signal 3 = event year; signal 7 = +4 years
    year = signal - 3L,

    sex_label = case_when(
      sex == 2 ~ "A. Female partners",
      sex == 1 ~ "B. Male partners",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    group_label = case_when(
      group == 1 ~ "Parent couples",
      group == 0 ~ "Non-parenting couples",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  n_distinct(outcome_long$couple_id[outcome_long$group == 1]) == 709L,
  n_distinct(outcome_long$couple_id[outcome_long$group == 0]) == 893L
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Compute weighted observed means in each of the 20 imputations
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

trajectory_by_imp <- map_dfr(
  seq_along(weight_list),
  function(i) {

    w_i <- weight_list[[i]] %>%
      transmute(
        couple_id = as.character(couple_id),
        weight = as.numeric(att_weight_ebal)
      )

    stopifnot(
      nrow(w_i) == 1602L,
      n_distinct(w_i$couple_id) == 1602L,
      all(is.finite(w_i$weight)),
      all(w_i$weight > 0)
    )

    outcome_long %>%
      left_join(
        w_i,
        by = "couple_id"
      ) %>%
      group_by(
        group,
        group_label,
        sex,
        sex_label,
        signal,
        year
      ) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_ls = weighted.mean(
          life_sat,
          w = weight,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        n_observed = sum(!is.na(life_sat)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        .imp = i,
        .before = 1
      )
  }
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Average the weighted means across the 20 imputed weight sets
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

trajectory_means <- trajectory_by_imp %>%
  group_by(
    group,
    group_label,
    sex,
    sex_label,
    signal,
    year
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    # BUG FIX: compute min/max BEFORE the overwrite of mean_ls.
    # dplyr::summarise evaluates left-to-right, so the old code
    # (mean_ls first, then min/max) made both diagnostics equal
    # to the already-computed scalar mean.
    min_mean = min(mean_ls),
    max_mean = max(mean_ls),
    mean_ls = mean(mean_ls),
    n_observed = first(n_observed),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    sex,
    group,
    year
  )

print(
  trajectory_means,
  n = Inf
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Publication figure
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

p_fig1 <- ggplot(
  trajectory_means,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = mean_ls,
    colour = group_label,
    linetype = group_label,
    group = group_label
  )
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.55,
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ sex_label,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = -3:4,
    labels = c(
      "−3", "−2", "−1", "0",
      "+1", "+2", "+3", "+4"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(7.0, 8.0, by = 0.25),
    labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(7.0, 8.0)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Parent couples" = "#0072B2",
      "Non-parenting couples" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "Parent couples" = "solid",
      "Non-parenting couples" = "dashed"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Years relative to childbirth / pseudo-event",
    y = "Life satisfaction",
    colour = NULL,
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "center",

    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "black"
    ),

    panel.spacing = unit(
      1.3,
      "lines"
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      10, 15, 10, 10
    )
  )

print(p_fig1)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "figures",
    "Figure1_observed_weighted_trajectories.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_fig1,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "figures",
    "Figure1_observed_weighted_trajectories.png"
  ),
  plot = p_fig1,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
